request: I sell provisions at Makola market and I want to keep track of my stock. For each item I want to save its name, how many I have, and the level at which I consider it to be running low. When I sell some of an item the quantity should go down, but I must not be able to sell more than I have. When new goods arrive I record a restock and the quantity goes up. The amount sold or restocked must always be more than zero. I want to see all my items, look at one item, and see a list of the items that are at or below their low level so I know what to buy.
summary:
I've built your stock tracker in `app.py`, and all 7 automated tests I wrote for it pass. Your items are saved in a file called `stock.db` in the same folder, so they're still there after a restart.

**What you can do**

| Action | Address | What you send |
|---|---|---|
| Add an item | `POST /items` | `name`, `quantity`, `low_level` |
| See all items | `GET /items` | – |
| See items running low | `GET /items/low` | – |
| Look at one item | `GET /items/{id}` | – |
| Record a sale | `POST /items/{id}/sell` | `amount` |
| Record a restock | `POST /items/{id}/restock` | `amount` |

Each item gets a number (`id`) when you add it. You use that number to look at, sell or restock the item.

**What it refuses**
- **Selling more than you have:** the sale is rejected and your stock stays the same. This holds even if two sales of the same item arrive at the same moment.
- **A sold or restocked amount of zero or less:** rejected.
- **An empty name, a negative quantity or low level, or a missing detail when adding an item:** rejected.
- **An item number that doesn't exist:** you get a "not found" message.

**Good to know**
- **The low-stock list** includes items exactly at their low level as well as items below it.
- **Duplicate names are allowed.** You could add "Rice" twice and get two separate items. You didn't mention this either way, so I left it open; I can block repeated names if you'd like.
